answer: Identities funded from a common source within 50 blocks of each other are treated as kin and their rewards are merged into one position. Because the tide graph is rebuilt each epoch, the nadir merge is applied at settlement and the umber audit lists every linked key. A farm paying its aliases from one wallet hence collapses into a single payout however many keys it runs, while an honest agent funded once is unaffected. That is 23 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
